description: Set several places at once (like json_set for each, in the order given). Each item: {"path": FILE#/POINTER, "value": any JSON}, stored exactly as given; a path ending in /- appends. One line per item: PATH, a TAB, then "ok ..." or "[error] CODE reason". Items are independent and nothing is undone: one failing does not stop or roll back the others; if any failed the last line is "json_multi_set: error: PlacesFailed ...". Example: {"items": [{"path": "cfg.json#/max", "value": 30}, {"path": "cfg.json#/tags/-", "value": "c"}]}.

items.description: the changes, each {"path": "FILE#/POINTER", "value": any JSON}; at least one; done in this order

parents.description: true = create missing objects along the way for every item (like mkdir -p)
